notes: Twelve tariff facts across M-PESA consumer, B2C, B2B, business till, Airtel Money, two bank PesaLink tariffs and Fuliza. All M-PESA and Airtel rows are quoted as raw extracted table rows because the columns interleave on extraction; display carries the cleaned reading. Retail tariff tables are the most volatile material in the corpus.

entries.subject: mpesa_send_money_fee
entries.display: KSh 7 to send KSh 101-500 to another M-PESA user
entries.notes: Row read from the tariff table: band 101-500, transfer to M-PESA users = 7, transfer to other-network registered mobile money users = 7, withdrawal at agent = 29. Columns interleaved in extraction; the 7 is the send-money charge.

entries.subject: mpesa_send_money_fee
entries.display: KSh 108 to send KSh 50,001-250,000 (flat top band)
entries.notes: Top band of the M-PESA send-money table: 108 to M-PESA users, 108 to other networks, 309 agent withdrawal.

entries.subject: mpesa_agent_withdrawal_fee
entries.display: KSh 52 to withdraw KSh 2,501-3,500 at an M-PESA agent

entries.subject: mpesa_agent_withdrawal_fee
entries.display: KSh 309 to withdraw KSh 50,001-250,000 at an M-PESA agent
entries.notes: Same row as the top send band; 309 is the agent withdrawal charge.

entries.subject: mpesa_cash_deposit_fee
entries.display: Deposits at an M-PESA agent are free
entries.quote: other transactions kes all deposits free m pesa registration free buying airtime through m pesa free m pesa balance enquiry free change m pesa pin free
entries.notes: The page's 'other transactions' block lists deposits, registration, airtime, balance enquiry and PIN change as free.

entries.subject: mpesa_b2c_fee
entries.display: KSh 5 charged to the business for a B2C payment of KSh 101-500 to a registered user
entries.notes: B2C tariff form: columns are customer charge / business charge / total, so 0 / 5 / 5 for band 101-500. Customer pays nothing.

entries.subject: mpesa_b2b_fee
entries.display: KSh 8 B2B charge for KSh 101-500, paid by the initiating organisation
entries.quote: b2b tariff band charge min max 1 49 2 50 100 3 101 500 8
entries.notes: Tariff form carries no explicit date; 2025 is from the document title. 'Charges are payable by the initiating party'.

entries.subject: merchant_collection_charge_cap
entries.display: Business till collection charge is capped at KSh 200 per transaction
entries.quote: the business owner will be charged a maximum of 0 5% and not more than ksh 200 per transaction for money collected on the till
entries.notes: The same page states 0.25% capped at KSh 200 in one table and 0.5% capped at KSh 200 in the note; only the KSh 200 cap is consistent across both.

entries.subject: airtel_transfer_to_other_network_fee
entries.display: KSh 7 to send KSh 101-500 from Airtel Money to another network
entries.notes: Airtel table row 101-500: Airtel-to-Airtel free, transfer to other networks 7, withdrawal 29. The page states no effective or publication date and effective_from is therefore left null.

entries.subject: pesalink_fee
entries.display: KSh 50 PesaLink charge at Family Bank for KSh 1,001-10,000
entries.notes: Family Bank's own PesaLink tariff, effective 1 July 2020; transfers of KSh 10-1,000 are free.

entries.subject: pesalink_fee
entries.display: KSh 20 flat (plus excise duty) for NCBA PesaLink transfers above KSh 1,000
entries.quote: transactions of above kes 1 000 kes 20 per transaction plus excise duty
entries.notes: Contrasts with Family Bank's banded 2020 tariff: PesaLink pricing is set by each participant bank, not centrally.

entries.subject: fuliza_access_fee
entries.display: Fuliza charges a one-off 1% access fee on the amount drawn
entries.quote: fuliza charges a customer will be charged a one off 1% access fee and a daily maintenance fee is applied the next day
entries.notes: Daily maintenance fee is separate and carries 20% excise duty.
